source_revision_limitation: The GitHub commit archives already-existing local files after the recorded synthetic run. It is not a pre-test source or claim commitment.

run.environment_limits: The README only identifies an earlier execution environment, not its reproducibly pinned packages, host load or kernel details. No source control revision is independently established as preceding the run.
run.declared_source_requirements: Python 3.9 or newer, standard library only
run.source_mechanism: Three child processes; cooperative pause, mutator, and observer sharing a local test buffer; no kernel freeze

review.method: Local SHA-256 and JSON semantic consistency verification of pre-existing files; GitHub read-back equality checked after archival.
review.limitation: Validation environment is not claimed to be the experiment's original execution environment.

admissible_conclusion: Stored results are internally consistent and demonstrate synthetic cooperative-stop race behavior under the recorded settings; not proof of JIREH, eBPF/seccomp, kernel isolation, atomicity, or C3/C6 assurance.
future_reproduction: Re-run on a declared, isolated system with recorded command, exact source commit, Python/OS/kernel details, and independently preserved raw outputs. Treat each new run as separately versioned evidence.
